description:
Astral Ascension Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- An Omega core can govern your colony, with three administrator skills of its own.
- Only an Omega core can take a colony past size 10, up to size 15.

Colonies past size 10 become Arcology Worlds, then Ecumenopolises, then Hyper-Ecumenopolises: the planet turns into a city, lit day and night, with an orbital ring at size 15.
Take the Omega core away from one and it falls into a Great Civil War.
A continuation of Planetace's Astral Ascension, made with the original author's blessing.

Requires LunaLib.

Planets

The Omega Core Administrator
Assign an Omega core as administrator the same way as an Alpha core.
Ethereal Enlightenment: hazard rating -25%, ship quality +25%, every building's production x2 and demand halved, +1 maximum industries.
Acumenious Oracle: stability +3, ground defenses x3, fleet size x2.
Delphic Optimiser: colony income x1.25, colony upkeep x0.75, accessibility +50%.

Colonies Past Size 10
Colonies grow to size 10 on their own (the base game stops at 6; this is a setting). Past 10, only a colony governed by an Omega core keeps growing, up to 15.
Every size past 10 takes 1.5 times longer to reach than it normally would, and it compounds. Size 15 is a lifetime's work.

Size Stage Bonuses
11-12 Arcology World +1 maximum industries, accessibility +20%, colony income x1.25, ground defenses x1.5, fleet size +25%, hazard rating -25%
13-14 Ecumenopolis +2 maximum industries, accessibility +40%, colony income x1.5, ground defenses x2, fleet size +50%, hazard rating -50%
15 Hyper-Ecumenopolis +3 maximum industries, accessibility +60%, colony income x2, ground defenses x3, fleet size +100%, hazard rating -75%, ship quality +25%

So many people are hard to keep calm: stability -1 at size 11, -2 at sizes 12 and 13, -3 at sizes 14 and 15.

The Great Civil War
A colony past size 10 is too big to be governed by a lesser mind.
Try to remove its Omega core and you get a warning, the way the base game warns about a rogue Alpha core.
Go through with it and the colony drops to size 8, keeps an armed, ungoverned population in its ruins, and loses 5 stability for half a year. You get the core back.

AoTD Compatibility
AoTD - Theory of Toolbox doubles food demand, domestic goods demand and farm output with every colony size. Past size 10 that doubling is held at its size-10 amount, so one size 15 world cannot outweigh the rest of the Sector.
Below size 11 nothing changes. It can be switched off in the settings.

Settings
In LunaLib's settings menu (Shift+F2 in the campaign): the size limit without an Omega core (6 to 10), how much slower growth past 10 is, the AoTD cap, and Omega core drops.

Console commands
With Console Commands installed. Leave out the colony name to use the colony you are docked at.
aar_size <3-15> [colony] - set a colony's size past the usual 10, with its stage and planet look. Past 10 the colony needs an Omega core administrator first.
aar_growth <0-100> [colony] - set how far a colony has grown towards its next size.
aar_status [colony] - size, size limit, growth, administrator, stage and AoTD scaling.

FAQ
Where do I get Omega cores?
Destroyed Omega ships can drop the core that commanded them: 33% for a frigate, 66% for a destroyer, 99% for a cruiser, always for a capital. If Omega Core Everywhere is installed, its drop settings are used instead.
Can I run it with the original Astral Ascension?
No. This mod replaces it, and the game will not start with both enabled.
Can I continue a save from the original Astral Ascension?
No. Start a new game, or use a save that never had the original.
Can I add it to an existing save?
Yes.
Can I remove it from a save?
Not once a colony has an Omega core administrator or has grown past size 10.
What about big worlds from other mods?
They are left alone, unless you give one an Omega core administrator.

Credits
Astral Ascension by Planetace: the idea of the Omega core administrator and its three skills, colonies past size 10, and ecumenopolis worlds. This mod is written from scratch with their permission and uses none of the original's code or art.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Icons and planet art: Gemini

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.

Version log
1.0.0 - first stable release. No gameplay changes since 0.2.1.
0.2.1 - the size 15 stage is called Hyper-Ecumenopolis.
0.2.0 - new size 15 stage with an orbital ring around the planet; Ecumenopolis is now sizes 13-14; colonies past size 10 lose stability; rewritten size descriptions.
0.1.0 - first release.
